purpose: Quantify how declared finite-temperature cavity/qubit thermal channels alter static and driven DCE QFI.

units.gd: existing normalized additive DCE coefficient, dimensionless
units.cavity_frequency: GHz (linear frequency used only for thermal occupations)
units.time: drive periods of the canonical drive frequency

thermal_model.cavity_channels: L_- = sqrt(kappa (n_th+1)) a and L_+ = sqrt(kappa n_th) a^dagger
thermal_model.qubit_channels: L_- = sqrt(gamma1 (n_q+1)) sigma_minus and L_+ = sqrt(gamma1 n_q) sigma_plus, included only for declared rows
thermal_model.occupation_formula: n = 1/(exp(h nu / k_B T) - 1) evaluated at the declared physical frequency

initial_states.vacuum: bare cavity vacuum tensor qubit ground
initial_states.dressed: ground state of the static Hamiltonian at the row coupling
initial_states.bare_thermal: thermal cavity state at n_th tensor qubit ground

thermal_model.zero_temperature_reference: matched family row at T=0 keeping spontaneous-emission collapse operators

validation.numerical_physicality_note: Trace/Hermiticity/eigenvalue acceptance is not a proof of exact positivity.
validation.retention_criterion_note: Sampled crossover flags use the declared retention fraction on peak QFI; this is a sampled criterion, not a critical temperature.

n_th_1e-4_at_20mK_6GHz.basis: Explicit Bose-Einstein occupation at the declared cavity frequency; the stored 6 GHz value at 20 mK is ~5.6e-7, three orders below 1e-4.

fourfold_reduction_at_100mK.basis: The stored 6 GHz occupations (5.6e-7 at 20 mK to 5.95e-2 at 100 mK) do not follow a fourfold-reduction law; QFI retention crosses the sampled 80% criterion near 100 mK for the canonical driven row instead.

caveats: Results are model-specific finite-window Lindblad calculations; no universal thermal threshold or platform-independent operating limit follows.
Thermal occupations are recorded from the Bose-Einstein formula at the declared frequency; they are not inferred without recording that frequency.
The finite-temperature channel is not an exact USC-bath treatment; hierarchy/memory corrections are outside this package.
Retention is relative to the matched zero-temperature reference row with the same protocol, coupling, loss, initial-state family, window, and truncation.
The historical n_th approximately 1e-4 at 20 mK and fourfold-reduction hypotheses are treated as hypotheses to reproduce, not assumptions.
Initial-state choices (vacuum, dressed, bare thermal) are declared models; their spread is reported rather than averaged away.
The time-dependent effective USC Hamiltonian retains the manuscript gauge/control caveat.
